# [trial: Claude head] Close cards automatically when their PR is merged

## Goal
Cards whose work is merged must not stay in "review" forever. Today 12 head cards sit in review although their PRs are merged (daily metrics "stale cards"). When a task's PR is merged on GitHub, the task should move to done automatically (and an open/closed-unmerged PR should leave it alone).

## How
1. Context first: does MC already detect merged PRs anywhere (grep for pr_url, pr_number, "merged", GitHub polling/watchers, the token harvester, heads launcher result handling, night shift)? Which decision applies (docs/decisions — ADR-085 frozen fleet layer: do NOT touch dispatch/healers; heads launcher is allowed)? Write the context brief into the run record.
2. Smallest correct design: a periodic check in the worker (existing scheduler/service, not a new loop if one fits) for tasks in review/user_test with a pr_url, asking GitHub (existing GitHub client/token config) whether the PR is merged → move the task to done through the normal status path (activity event, actor = system), with rate limiting and no calls when no token is configured. Head cards: make sure the head result path stores pr_url on the task when known.
3. Red test first, then implementation, then a sabotage probe; tests must not call the real GitHub (mock the client).
4. kz check (with your PR body) 0 new; map any new endpoint/setting in docs/produkt/landkarte.yaml.
5. Never use --no-verify or bypass any check. Push your branch; the orchestrator opens the PR.

## Done when
A merged PR moves its task to done within one check interval; unmerged/closed PRs don't; tests + sabotage probe green; run record has the context brief and the operator-facing behaviour in 3 sentences.

This is a scratch repo whose origin is a local bare repo: no pull request is possible here.
In step 6 run `git push -u origin mc-head/2026-10-01-trial-claude-head-close-cards-fcbf` and skip `gh pr create`.
